newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica's Glenvaal, MIB to merge, may list H2 1997.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica's Glenvaal, MIB to merge, may list H2 1997.

text.p: South Africa's Glenvaal Dewar Rand Ltd and MIB Group Ltd said on Wednesday they had agreed in principle to merge their operations and anticipated that the new group would be listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange in the second half of the year.
The groups, which are active in risk management and insurance broking, said in a joint announcement that the new firm would be known as Glenrand MIB Holdings Ltd.
They said the shareholders in both companies would exchange their shares for stocks in the merged group.

The merger would combine the strengths of both companies to enhance their ability to deliver improved service and resources in response to clients' needs, they said. It would also present opportunities for expansion of current operations.
While Glenrand and MIB would continue to retain their respective identitites and trade marks, it was anticipated that rationalisation would evolve.
